meta.description: Net-new events merged during this refresh. Window: 2026-09-04 to 2026-09-06 (Friday plus weekend, so additions are expectedly thin). Net-new: BCG published two AI articles on 09-04 (agentic AI for health insurers, chemical companies in the AI infrastructure boom). Documented backfills of official signals missed in the 09-03 round: Bain-Anthropic global partnership / Claude Partner Network Global Premier tier (08-25), Deloitte end-to-end AI Controls and Assurance expansion (08-12), and Bain FinOps for AI brief (09-03, published the same day as the previous refresh). EY, KPMG, Accenture, PwC, Oliver Wyman, Kearney, FTI Consulting, Alvarez & Marsal, Strategy&, and Monitor Deloitte had no verifiable net-new public AI signals in the window.

events.title: BCG 发布《Agentic AI's Advantage for Health Insurers》：更快决策、更低成本、更好服务
events.title_en: BCG publishes Agentic AI's Advantage for Health Insurers: Faster Decisions, Lower Costs, Better Care
events.summary: BCG 于 2026-09-04 发布医疗保险公司 agentic AI 应用研究，论证 AI agent 通过自动化理赔决策、客服与后台流程带来更快决策、更低成本与更好会员体验，把 agentic AI 从概念讨论推进到行业级价值测算，延续其在垂直行业 agentic AI 价值兑现上的研究线。
events.summary_en: On September 4, 2026, BCG published research on agentic AI for health insurers, arguing that AI agents automate claims decisions, service, and back-office workflows to deliver faster decisions, lower costs, and better member experience, moving agentic AI from concept to industry-level value measurement.

events.title: BCG 发布化工企业 AI 基础设施热潮机会研究
events.title_en: BCG publishes Opportunities for Chemical Companies in the AI Infrastructure Boom
events.summary: BCG 于 2026-09-04 发布研究，分析 AI 基础设施建设热潮（数据中心、电力与特种材料需求）为化工企业带来的新增长机会，把 AI 议题延伸到上游材料与工业供应链。
events.summary_en: On September 4, 2026, BCG published research analyzing how the AI infrastructure boom creates new growth opportunities for chemical companies via data center, power, and specialty materials demand, extending the AI agenda upstream into materials and industrial supply chains.

events.title: Bain 与 Anthropic 达成全球合作，以 Global Premier 级别加入 Claude Partner Network
events.title_en: Bain & Company announces global partnership with Anthropic, joining the Claude Partner Network at Global Premier tier
events.summary: Bain 于 2026-08-25 宣布与 Anthropic 达成全球合作，以 Global Premier 级别加入 Claude Partner Network，把 Claude 模型与 Bain 的行业与转型方法论结合，加速客户企业级 AI 落地。该条发布于上一轮刷新窗口内（08-25），属上一轮漏检，本轮追溯回填。
events.summary_en: On August 25, 2026, Bain announced a global partnership with Anthropic, joining the Claude Partner Network at the Global Premier tier, combining Claude models with Bain's industry and transformation expertise to accelerate enterprise AI deployment. Backfilled after being missed in the 09-03 refresh.

events.title: Bain 发布《FinOps for AI: From Managing Costs to Maximizing Value》
events.title_en: Bain publishes FinOps for AI: From Managing Costs to Maximizing Value
events.summary: Bain 于 2026-09-03（上一轮刷新当日，漏检回填）发布 FinOps for AI 简报，主张 AI 支出管理应从单纯控制成本转向价值最大化，把成本、用量与业务结果放在同一视图里实时跟踪和决策，回应企业 AI 投入回报核算的普遍痛点。
events.summary_en: On September 3, 2026, Bain published a FinOps for AI brief arguing that AI spend management should shift from cost control to value maximization by tracking costs, usage, and business outcomes in one real-time view. Published the same day as the previous refresh and backfilled after being missed.

events.title: Deloitte 扩展端到端 AI Controls and Assurance 能力，帮助组织负责任地规模化 AI
events.title_en: Deloitte expands end-to-end AI Controls and Assurance capabilities
events.summary: Deloitte 于 2026-08-12 宣布扩展端到端 AI Controls and Assurance 服务，采用 human-led、AI-powered 方法帮助组织在有信心的前提下采纳、规模化并治理 AI。该条属上一轮（09-03）漏检的官方信号，本轮追溯回填；它与 09-02 的 Open Model Engineering practice 共同构成 Deloitte 在 AI 交付与 AI 治理两端的扩张。
events.summary_en: On August 12, 2026, Deloitte announced expanded end-to-end AI Controls and Assurance capabilities using a human-led, AI-powered approach to help organizations adopt, scale, and govern AI responsibly. Backfilled after being missed in the 09-03 refresh; together with the 09-02 Open Model Engineering practice it marks Deloitte's expansion on both the delivery and governance sides of AI.
